evals.name: cafe-30-cover
evals.prompt: I've taken a ground-floor unit that's about 12 metres by 8 metres, single open shell with the entrance on one of the 12m sides facing the street. I want to run a 30-cover cafe in it with a small open kitchen and a customer toilet. Can you lay it out for me, tell me whether 30 covers actually fits, and flag anything that would fail an inspection? I'm in Bengaluru.
evals.expected_output: A JSON floor plan (meters, schema-compliant) + a rendered to-scale 2D SVG showing walls, a ~30-seat dining zone, an open kitchen, and a toilet, with the entrance on a 12m wall. Plus a clearance/egress sanity check (NBC 2016 assembly occupancy) and an honest fits/doesn't-fit verdict with the disclaimer.

evals.name: gym-mezzanine
evals.prompt: My mezzanine floor is 9m x 6m. I want to put 4 treadmills along one wall and a small free-weights area with a bench and a rack. Is that enough space to be safe and usable, and how would you arrange it? Draw it.
evals.expected_output: A JSON plan + 2D SVG for a 9x6m room with 4 treadmills (respecting ~0.6m side / 1.83m rear clearance) and a free-weights zone, plus a spacing sanity check against gym clearance standards (6ft between patrons) and an arrangement rationale.

evals.name: coworking-10-desk
evals.prompt: Can you plan a coworking room for 10 desks? The room is 10m x 7m with a single door in one corner. I want to make sure the walkways between desk rows aren't too tight and that people can actually move around.
evals.expected_output: A JSON plan + 2D SVG placing 10 desks in a 10x7m room, with circulation aisles checked against coworking standards (>=0.9m between rows, 75-125 sqft/desk reality check) and a note on whether 10 desks is comfortable or cramped.
